title: Family, auctions and estates
body: Use /family in the bot channel. A Ring proposal requires the target’s decision and expires after 24 hours. A Wedding Sack guarantees the bot marriage. Each second marriage consumes its own Blessing. Spouses keep separate finances. Marriage-card votes are anonymous, editable and exclude both spouses; more than 80% approval with at least five voters unlocks only the first child slot. Divorce after three days transfers half one randomly chosen spouse’s liquid Ottomans; the same pair waits seven days to remarry. Adoption needs a married pair with an open slot and the child’s acceptance. Disown/emancipate wait three days. Only active links appear in the family tree. Self-auctions use private increasing escrowed bids for spouse/child roleplay, last 1–72 hours and pay the person auctioned. A will chooses one beneficiary. Departure starts a 24-hour estate grace; returning cancels an unexecuted estate. Executed inheritance is irreversible and never restores assets or starter funds on rejoin.

fields.member: Target member; familytree defaults to yourself.
fields.item: Ring or Wedding Sack. Have unlocked required items and a Blessing when taking a second spouse.
fields.type: Auction yourself as spouse or child roleplay.
fields.hours: Auction duration from one to 72 hours; default 24.
fields.reserve: Optional minimum winning Ottoman bid. Sealed bids cannot decrease or withdraw.

steps: Obtain required family items through the shared Shop and keep them unlocked.
Choose the member and Ring/Sack behavior; read the public proposal or marriage result.
Use the marriage’s own voting controls and View Family.
Allow child-slot and minimum relationship ages to mature before family changes.
Review sealed-bid amounts before confirming; losing bids are refunded at settlement.
Set your will and understand the departure grace and irreversible estate result.
